goal: Curriculum competency catalog in backend/history_models.py, backend routers, and frontend.
summary: Implemented curriculum competency catalog conforming to the Vietnam 2018 General Education Program (GDPT 2018: Historical Literacy, Source Criticism & Epistemic Reasoning, Historical Empathy, Historical Communication) mapped to grade bands (Grades 6–12) and real relics (Cửu Đỉnh 9 Urns and 162 Motifs). Created database models CurriculumCompetency, CurriculumCompetencyRelicMapping, and CurriculumCompetencyFlag in backend/history_models.py and purely additive Alembic migration 0075_curriculum_competency_catalog.py. Built backend service backend/services/curriculum_competency.py with comprehensive validation, teacher editing workflows, and inaccuracy flagging. Added 10 RESTful endpoints to backend/routers/history_learning.py and Pydantic schemas in backend/apischemas/history_learning.py. Enforced negative abuse defenses where unreviewed mappings strictly surface review warnings, learners/guests are rejected with HTTP 403 from mutating or flagging mappings, and out-of-bounds grades (<6 or >12) receive HTTP 422. Developed frontend component CurriculumCompetencyCatalog.tsx with full bilingual typing and Vitest test coverage.

invariants_enforced.standard_competencies_gdpt_2018: Standard 4 competencies under Vietnam 2018 General Education Program (Historical Literacy, Source Criticism, Historical Empathy, Historical Communication) systematically cataloged with progressive grade descriptors across Grades 6–7, 8–9, and 10–12.
invariants_enforced.real_relic_mappings: Competencies map directly to authentic historical entities and Cửu Đỉnh relics (Cao Đỉnh, Nhân Đỉnh, Chương Đỉnh, Tuyên Đỉnh, 162 Motifs, and classical administrative statutes).
invariants_enforced.review_warning_invariant: Any mapping that has not been reviewed (is_reviewed=False) strictly displays a visible review warning banner ('Cảnh báo: Ánh xạ năng lực chưa được thẩm định chuyên môn bởi giáo viên cốt cán') across all list and single GET responses.
invariants_enforced.teacher_editable_and_feedback: Teachers (UserRole.teacher, admin, super_admin) can create new relic mappings and edit existing mappings with strict secondary school grade bounds validation (min_grade and max_grade between 6 and 12).
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_teacher_flagging: Teachers can flag inaccurate competency mappings with structured reasons (inaccurate_grade_level, misaligned_competency, historical_inaccuracy, pedagogical_concern, other) and commentary. Mappings immediately transition to status='flagged' and surface the warning notice.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_non_teacher_blocked: Learners, guests, and unauthenticated users attempting to create, edit, or flag competency mappings are strictly rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden or HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_invalid_grade_bounds: Grade levels below 6, above 12, or with min_grade > max_grade are rejected with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Content.
invariants_enforced.administrative_verification_and_resoluti: Admins and staff can resolve teacher flags and verify mappings, transitioning them to is_reviewed=True, status='verified', and clearing review warnings.

changes.description: Added models CurriculumCompetency, CurriculumCompetencyRelicMapping, and CurriculumCompetencyFlag with Enums StandardCompetencyDomain, CompetencyGradeBand, CompetencyMappingStatus, and CompetencyFlagReason.
Exported CurriculumCompetency, CurriculumCompetencyRelicMapping, CurriculumCompetencyFlag, and domain enums so Base.metadata includes them for Alembic and conftest create_all.

Created purely additive Alembic migration 0075_curriculum_competency_catalog creating curriculum_competencies, curriculum_competency_relic_mappings, and curriculum_competency_flags tables and indexes.

Implemented domain service containing STANDARD_GDPT_COMPETENCIES, ensure_default_competencies, validate_grade_range, teacher permission checks, create/update mapping, flag_relic_mapping, list_mapping_flags, resolve_mapping_flag, and verify_relic_mapping.

Added Pydantic schemas: CurriculumCompetencyOut, CurriculumCompetencyListOut, CurriculumCompetencyRelicMappingIn, CurriculumCompetencyRelicMappingUpdateIn, CurriculumCompetencyRelicMappingOut, CurriculumCompetencyRelicMappingListOut, CurriculumCompetencyFlagIn, CurriculumCompetencyFlagOut, CurriculumCompetencyFlagResolveIn.

Added 10 endpoints under /api/v1/history/curriculum/competencies for catalog retrieval, relic mappings query, teacher creation, teacher updates, inaccuracy flagging, flag resolution, and verification.
Added DDL definitions for curriculum_competencies, curriculum_competency_relic_mappings, and curriculum_competency_flags to test database bootstrap.
Created TypeScript interface definitions for competencies, relic mappings, flags, grade descriptors, and input mutations.
Built interactive React component featuring 4 GDPT 2018 competencies, grade band filters, search, review warning banners, flagged alert displays, teacher edit modal, and teacher flagging modal.
Added Vitest unit test suite verifying rendering, review warnings on unreviewed mappings, flagged banners, verified badges, and teacher action button permissions.

Created 10-test integration test suite verifying standard competencies, relic mappings, review warning invariant, teacher editing, negative abuse non-teacher blocks, grade bounds validation, teacher flagging, and admin flag resolution.
